narration: You probably overpaid today — and never knew it. An algorithm quietly charged you more than the person right next to you. That's dynamic pricing.
visual: A large hexagonal price tag with a price counter rapidly cycling between $4.99, $12.49, $8.99, $15.99 — same item label underneath. Upward red arrow pulses. 'DYNAMIC PRICING IS WATCHING YOU' appears.

narration: Airlines invented it back in 1983. Same seat, same flight — the person next to you paid 73% less. It all depended on when they booked.
visual: Two airplane seats side by side — blue seat labeled $180 'TUESDAY BOOKING', red seat labeled $520 'FRIDAY BOOKING'. Both slide in from opposite sides. '73% MORE — SAME SEAT' badge springs in below.

narration: Now it's in fast food, groceries, and concert tickets. McDonald's digital menus change prices based on demand. The price literally updates while you watch.
visual: SVG burger icon beside a glowing digital price board showing $5.99 → $7.49 → $8.99 cycling. List of industries fades in one by one: Fast Food, Grocery Stores, Ride Apps, Concert Tickets.

narration: The algorithm knows your device, your location, and your purchase history. It builds a profile and prices you on desperation. You're not a customer — you're a target.
visual: Phone silhouette in center of frame. Three data icons orbit it — LOCATION pin (amber), EYE/DEVICE (blue), SHOPPING CART/HISTORY (red). Animated lines connect them to phone. Arrow extends right to a server box labeled PRICE ENGINE.

narration: Studies show dynamic pricing costs the average shopper twenty-four hundred dollars every single year. Peak prices run 300% above normal. That's not a coincidence — it's a system.
visual: Bar chart: green 'NORMAL' bar at $10 grows first, then red 'PEAK' bar at $30 grows to 3x height. '300%' badge springs onto the peak bar. $2,400 counter animates up to show annual cost.

narration: Here's how to fight back. Shop off-peak, search in incognito mode, and never rush a purchase. That urgency you feel is engineered — don't buy into it. Follow for more.
visual: Person silhouette with amber shield and checkmark. Four checklist items appear one by one: Search incognito / clear cookies, Shop off-peak hours, Compare prices before buying, Never rush — urgency is engineered. Dark CTA bar at bottom: FOLLOW FOR MORE MONEY MOVES.
